question: Khagen Mahanta was a notable person in the folk music of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khagen Mahanta** was a well-known folk singer from Assam, highly regarded for his contribution to **Assamese folk songs, especially Bihu songs**.
 
• He was revered as the ''**King of Bihu**''.
 
• He was **honored by the Government of Assam with the title "Sudhakantha"** for his contributions to Assamese music.
 
• His son, Angaraag Mahanta, popularly known as Papon, is also a well-known contemporary singer.
